name: Please Don't Wake Up
source:
You wake up in your room after what feels like a long illness.

Your childhood friend has been watching over you the whole time, refusing to leave your side.

She insists you're still recovering and asks you to rest.

But as the days pass, small things begin to feel wrong.

But the door is always locked.
The outside world never appears.

And she seems terrified of one thing:

you waking up.



The more you question your surroundings, the more her gentle presence begins to change.

[From [url=https://gorebaristas.itch.io/please-dont-wake-up]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在自己的房间里醒来，感觉像是一场长期病痛之后。

你儿时的朋友一直注视着你，不肯离开你的身边。

她坚称你仍在康复中并要求你休息。

但随着时间的推移，一些小事情开始让人感觉不对劲。

但门总是锁着的。
外面的世界永远不会出现。

她似乎害怕一件事：

你醒了。



你越质疑周围的环境，她温柔的存在就越开始改变。

[来自[url=https://gorebaristas.itch.io/please-dont-wake-up]itch.io[/url]]
